name: Todd D. Murphey
title: Professor; Director of the Master of Science in Robotics Program
fitReason: Direct fit for robot learning that runs on hardware, including sample-efficient online learning, soft-robot adaptation and physical exploration without relying on high-fidelity simulators.

physicalEvidence.summary: CASE2025 NoodleBot work benchmarks RL algorithms learning from scratch on a physical untethered three-link robot. CoRL2025 RKL validates recursive learned control on real soft-actuated hardware. RSS2026 LEAP learns to adapt a6-DoF HSA soft wrist to physical damage and repair; this latter setup is collaborative with Ryan Truby.
